record.question: Which statement accurately describes the Indirect Coombs test?
options: It is used to find antibodies on the surface of RBCs
It adds Coombs reagent directly to the patient's RBC
It detects free-floating antibodies in the patient's serum that cause RBCs to be destroyed
It is primarily used to diagnose autoimmune disorders
record.explanation: Answer C: It detects free-floating antibodies in the patient's serum that cause RBCs to be destroyed. The indirect antiglobulin test detects serum/plasma antibodies that can react with reagent red cells. The printed option is overstrong: detection alone does not establish that the antibodies cause in-vivo RBC destruction. Reference: https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/mesh/68003298; https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/books/NBK585033/. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
